I implemented Lion on HW06, after adding Manifold MuOn too to have more methods to compare. Questions associated to this new section are: 

Question 10 : Briefly explain how Lion's update is different from AdamW in terms of:

number of state tensors per parameter

use (or non-use) of the gradient magnitude.

Question 11 : Uncomment the Lion contribution to the optimizer dictionnary. Compare Lion and AdamW:

Which optimizer reaches lower training loss after 5 epochs?

Which optimizer achieves higher test accuracy?
